q: What does this sign mean?

q: What does this sign mean?

q: What does this sign mean?

q: What does this sign mean?

q: What does this sign mean?

e: Bike + red slash = no bicycles.

q: What does this sign mean?

q: What does this sign mean?

q: What does this sign mean?

w: Maximum safe speed for the curve ahead
Speed limit when the lights are flashing

q: What does this sign mean?

e: Two cars inside a red circle with a slash = no passing.

q: What does this sign mean?

w: School zone: lower speed limit during school hours
No through traffic in this community
e: Community safety zone = higher fines for traffic offences.

q: What does this sign mean?

w: Turn right at the next intersection
e: A black-and-white arrow sign = one-way road.

w: Taxis and buses may park here

q: Which sign means: do not turn right when facing a red light?

q: Which sign means: do not turn left during the times shown?

q: Which sign means: slow traffic on multi-lane roads must keep right?
a: signs/3-1-23.jpg

q: Which sign tells you the speed limit is lower during school hours, when the yellow lights are flashing?
a: signs/3-1-25.jpg

q: Which sign shows the direction you must travel from each lane?
a: signs/3-1-27.jpg
e: Lane-use arrows, above the road or on the pavement, show what each lane must do.
s: These signs, above the road or on the pavement before an intersection, tell drivers the direction they must travel.

q: Which sign marks a pedestrian crossover?
a: signs/3-1-29.jpg
e: The crossover sign shows a big X and says "Pedestrian". Be prepared to stop and yield.
s: This is a pedestrian crossover. Be prepared to stop and yield right-of-way to pedestrians.

q: Which sign means the lane is only for two-way left turns?
a: signs/3-1-30.jpg
e: Two curved arrows pointing opposite ways = two-way left-turn lane.
s: This sign, above the road or on the ground, means the lane is only for two-way left turns.

q: Which sign reserves a curb area for picking up and dropping off passengers with disabilities?
a: signs/3-1-31.jpg

q: Which sign means a lane is only for certain types of vehicles, such as buses, taxis or bicycles?

q: Which sign means: keep to the right lane except when passing on two-lane sections with climbing or passing lanes?
a: signs/3-1-33.jpg

q: Which sign means vehicles cannot change lanes into or out of the HOV lane in this area?

q: Which sign tells you to stop for a school bus when its signals are flashing?
a: signs/3-1-25b.jpg

q: What does this sign mean?

w: No stopping at all, not even for a moment
Stopping to load or unload passengers or merchandise

w: No stopping, not even for a moment
No standing: you may stop only for passengers
e: A P in a red circle with a slash = no parking. You may still stop briefly for passengers or goods.

w: No left turn only during rush hour

q: What does this sign mean?

w: Keep to the right of the traffic island

q: What does this sign mark?

A hidden school bus stop ahead
A school zone with a lower speed limit
e: School bus loading zone: buses load here without flashing red lights or the stop arm.

q: This sign says "both directions". Where is it used and what does it mean?

w: On divided highways: only traffic behind the bus must stop

At railway crossings: buses stop both ways

Keep right except to pass on two-lane sections with passing lanes

q: What does this sign mean?

e: School zone speed limit: it applies when the yellow lights are flashing.
